items.t: Why Is TeraWulf Stock Trending on Thursday?

items.t: TeraWulf Rises 6%, Cipher Digital Gains 5% After NVIDIA’s Record Quarter; IREN Climbs 4%
items.sum: NVIDIA's blowout forecast lit up the former bitcoin miners now leasing AI data centers, but a quiet warning about chip financing could shake the rally. Three stocks share one thesis, and they are not equally exposed.

items.t: TeraWulf Stock Climbs After Nvidia’s Better-Than-Expected Q3 Results
items.sum: TeraWulf Inc (NASDAQ:WULF) shares are rising Wednesday after Nvidia's strong quarter lifted AI cloud stocks.

items.t: RIOT, WULF Have Significant Upside Left: Bernstein
items.sum: Bernstein sees 76% upside for Riot and 68% for TeraWulf, citing undervalued AI data-center contracts as miners shift toward AI infrastructure.

items.t: TeraWulf Sinks 9% Despite Kentucky Power Deal for Muskie Data Campus; Applied Digital Tumbles 10%, Cipher Digital Drops 7%
items.sum: A fresh gigawatt-scale power deal should have lifted TeraWulf, yet the stock slid anyway as AI jitters hit data-center landlords. Its two closest rivals look far worse on the year, so can TeraWulf's edge survive the selloff?

items.t: TeraWulf (WULF) Backs Muskie Power Plan With Bill Credits And Grid Upgrades
items.sum: TeraWulf (NasdaqCM:WULF) is partnering with Kentucky Power on an infrastructure plan to support the Muskie Data Campus in Eastern Kentucky. The arrangement includes TeraWulf funding customer bill credits for Kentucky Power customers tied to the Muskie Data Campus project.
